overall: The AG found the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law: contract negotiations in executive session fell under Purpose 2, and the contracts were properly approved in open session.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by approving contracts for the Fire Chief, Police Chief and Town Administrator in executive session.
allegations.key_passage: Furthermore, the Board properly returned to open session to approve the contracts.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to disclose the amount of bonuses or salary raises for the three contract employees.
allegations.key_passage: The Board did not discuss job performance evaluations of these three employees or whether they merited a salary increase or bonus.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
